name: Gareth Pryce
message: Bit of background first, apologies in advance for the essay. We started as a two-person lettings office in 2011 and now manage about 2,400 rental units across four towns. For years our enquiries came by phone, so we never needed anything clever. Then the portals took off, and now we get tenant applications, landlord valuations, maintenance moans, people trying to sell us drone photography, the lot, all into one shared inbox that three people dip in and out of. Last month we lost a landlord with 40 units because nobody replied to his valuation request for nine days. That was the moment the board stopped laughing at my 'inbox robot' idea. I've read a bit about AI sorting tools but honestly I don't know what's realistic. What I do know: we've approved around £30k for this phase, it has to plug into our CRM (Reapit), and the board wants it running before the January rush, which for lettings is brutal. Could someone walk me through what you'd do?
